text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
T-Tap-san... I found your dropped 
smartphone...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Good thing we tracked it quickly with 
GPS... Geez, please don't let it fall out 
of your pocket again!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my bad! That thing just goes wandering 
off on its own sometimes!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you got messages from 
everyone else who split up? Better check 
it.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh hey, you're right. You saved me, 
rookie! You're really capable!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: N-No... haha. ...

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
(...Is it gonna keep being like this? 
Babysitting, flashing fake smiles... 
spending my days like that? Did I... 
really come here for this—)

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: ...Gh, Tap-san!! I'm... as of today, I'm—!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl with Sunglasses
text_block_list.text: Tap! Sorry, but get over here right now!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text:
—There's zero hype, I'm telling ya! —Like 
I said, the budget's already maxed out!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl with Sunglasses
text_block_list.text:
...And that's how it is. I get what both 
sides are saying, so we're stuck in a 
deadlock... Got any bright ideas?

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: H-Huh?! Ideas?! ...U-Um, well...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*Snap!*)

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what's all the fuss about?! We're 
setting up for a fun party, so why're you 
all wearing such gloomy faces?!

text_block_list.name: Dance Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text: —Tap!!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm here, I'll show you all a 
golden dream!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Come on now, there are way too few 
contestants! Man, I'll call some mates 
from the US! As special guests!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Huh... F-From America?! Will they really 
come all the way over just like that?!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Those guys'll move in a heartbeat if it 
means having fun. The answer's always 
"yes"!

text_block_list.name: Dance Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text:
Tap's friends are crossing the ocean for 
this...?! We can't just sit on our hands! 
Let's make the venue and stage effects way 
flashier!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
There you go, let your greed run wild! No 
regrets allowed! You're holding a massive 
treasure map, aren't ya?!

text_block_list.name: Tournament Staff
text_block_list.text:
—Yeaaah! Let's shoot some flames! —I wanna 
make the championship prize way more 
luxurious!! —Leave finding sponsors to 
meee!!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
I-I'll help too! I'll help out! I know 
someone who's a pyrotechnician...!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Aahaha! Cool! That's the spirit, go grab 
everything you want!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, go into this aiming to be the 
one having the most fun!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
That's right... That's how it is! Even if 
she's sloppy, even if she has uncool 
moments!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text: The Tap-san I admired is—!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While taking a walk, I ran into a rather 
lively group of people.

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, crap! I left my wallet behind at the 
venue...!

text_block_list.name: Rookie Horse Girl
text_block_list.text:
Jeez, I found it and brought it with me! 
Please attach it to your belt with a 
chain!

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
Oh... Haha, what're you grinning for? 
Don't tell me—

text_block_list.name: Tap Dance City
text_block_list.text:
You totally love me too, don'tcha? Huh! 
Ain't that right, my crewmate!
